reason: The README clearly describes an image-understanding tool that sends images to configurable vision models and returns structured spatial text, coordinates, relationships, and optional pixel grids.

summaries.zh: 将图片发送至可配置的视觉模型，并转换为包含空间坐标、元素关系和可选像素网格的结构化文字。
summaries.en: Sends images to a configurable vision model and converts them into structured text with spatial coordinates, element relationships, and optional pixel grids.
